page.title: Attendance
page.description: Daily overview, scan log, QR codes and attendance settings.

statusHint.absent: Working day with no arrival scanned
statusHint.exempt: Staff member exempt from clocking in

journal.badRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.

qr.searchHintChild: By surname, first names or ID.
qr.searchAria: Search for a person by name or ID
qr.title: QR code
qr.copyFailed: Could not copy — take the token from the manual scan entry instead.
qr.tokenHint: Paste this token into the manual entry on the Scanner tab if you get stuck.

export.intro: An aggregated attendance export (status per person, per day) as PDF or Excel, for children and/or staff. Limited to 366 days.
export.personHint: Search for a child or a staff member to export them alone. While someone is selected, the filters below are ignored.
export.searchPlaceholder: Search by surname, first name or nickname (2 letters min)…
export.periodHint: Quick presets or a custom range.
export.scopeHint: Who to export, and in which format.
export.badRange: The end date must be on or after the start date.

scan.title: Scan a badge
scan.hint: Turn on the camera and hold up the QR code.
scan.suggestionHint: The flashing light marks the event suggested by today's record.
scan.noSuggestion: No suggestion — pick the action you want.
scan.duplicateBody: This action ({event}) already exists for {person} today. Create a duplicate anyway?
scan.cameraUnsupported: This browser does not support the camera.
scan.errPermission: Camera access denied — allow it in your browser settings.
scan.errNoDevice: No camera found on this device.
scan.errInUse: The camera is already in use by another application.

settings.generalHint: A single schedule for all staff at the school — children are configured department by department.
settings.grace: Grace period before counting as late (minutes)
settings.departmentsHint: Expected hours for children — set per department (staff share a single schedule, see General).
settings.noDepartment: No departments yet. Create one from Organisation.
settings.deptDialogHint: Used to work out lateness for children in this department.
settings.staffDialogHint: Overrides the general schedule for this staff member. Restore the general schedule to fall back on the default.

dashboard.searchChild: Search for a child (surname, first name)…
dashboard.notifyHint: Send an email and a message to the parents of absent children
dashboard.notifyTitle: Notify the parents of absent children?
dashboard.notifyBody: {count} child(ren) with no arrival today. An email and a message will be sent to the assigned parent accounts to find out why — children already notified today are skipped.
dashboard.relaunchBody: An email and a message will be sent again to the assigned parent accounts, even if they were already notified today.
dashboard.noStaffMatch: No staff member matches this search.
dashboard.correctFailed: Correction failed ({fields}) — the other times were saved.
dashboard.noDataHint: No child is attached to your group, or no attendance event has been recorded.
dashboard.noScanWillCreate: No scan yet — one will be created.

graceHint: An arrival within this window after the expected time still counts as “present”. 0 means no leeway. Applies to children and staff alike.
staffScheduleHint: By default every staff member follows the general schedule (see General). Set an individual schedule here to override it when calculating that person’s lateness.
exemptHint: An exempt staff member is never counted as “absent” when they do not scan.
correctionHint: Only the times you change are saved. A time with no matching scan creates that entry.
noAccess: Insufficient rights — no access to the attendance module.
